The Soundcore AeroFit 2 looks like a good fit for running.

**Soundcore AeroFit 2 Open-Ear Earbuds**
- **Price:** $129.99 list, about $104 with the code **AFSC20**, which takes off $25.99.
- **Buy:** [Soundcore's official US store, via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-aerofit-2)

**Why it suits running**
- **Fit:** The ear hook is adjustable to 4 positions, and each bud weighs about 10 g.
- **Awareness:** The design leaves your ear canal open, so you can hear traffic.
- **Water resistance:** IP55 handles sweat and rain.
- **Battery:** You get 10 hours from the buds and 42 hours with the case. A 10-minute fast charge gives 4 hours.
- **Connectivity:** Bluetooth 5.4 with multipoint. LDAC is supported on Android only.
- **Case:** It charges wirelessly.

**Caveats**
- Open-ear designs leak sound and give no isolation. That makes them a poor choice for noisy places or quiet shared spaces.
- There's no ANC. Only the call microphones have AI noise reduction.
- The code is 20% off full-price items and isn't valid on items already on sale. It expires 2026-12-31.
- Dealectric tested the code in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, but prices change, so check the total at checkout.
- The link is an affiliate link. Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- Warranty is 18 months, with a 30-day money-back return.

I only checked this one product page, so I haven't compared it with other open-ear earbuds. If you'd like, I can look at some alternatives on Dealectric.
